title: LIC HFL Junior Assistant Interview Letter 2026
vacancyDetails: 180 Junior Assistant posts; interview call letters for shortlisted candidates
qualification: Graduation as per LIC HFL Junior Assistant 2026 advertisement
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years (as per notification; relaxations apply)
applicationFee: As per LIC HFL JA fee structure
documentsRequired: Interview call letter printout; original & attested educational certificates; photo ID; online application printout
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.lichousing.com
2. Open Junior Assistant Interview Call Letter link
3. Login with registration credentials
4. Download call letter (interviews till ~22 July 2026)
5. Attend interview with all original documents
shortDescription: LIC HFL Junior Assistant Interview Call Letter 2026 out on 15 July for 180 posts. Interviews scheduled till around 22 July 2026.
content:
LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) has released the Junior Assistant Interview Call Letter 2026 on 15 July 2026.

Online exam was held on 06 June 2026; result around 03 July 2026. Interviews for 180 posts were scheduled through mid/late July 2026.

Call letters are available only on lichousing.com (not sent by post). Carry originals of all certificates listed in the call letter.
